A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same AniDoc paper, including complete main text, references and Appendices A-F. All 13 pages support comparison; extracted text and rendered pages differ only in the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original AniDoc experiments, including quantitative comparisons in Table 1, component ablations in Table 2, and qualitative colorization and interpolation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original quantitative comparisons, ablations and qualitative experiments reported in v1, including the supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same diffusion architecture, correspondence guidance, binarization, background augmentation, dense/sparse sketch training and inference procedures.

E1.justification: The Sakuga-42M training coverage, anime colorization and interpolation tasks, and supplementary scenarios involving different backgrounds, multiple characters and line-art extraction methods are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 and Figure 5 retain the same comparators: ID-Animator, LVCD, LVCD + IP, and ToonCrafter + IP. No evaluated comparator is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Both retain the same training schedule and 200-clip evaluation, background removal, resizing to 256 by 256, and PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, FID and FVD metrics. Supplementary testing procedures also match.

E4.justification: Table 2 and Figure 6 retain the same component ablations. The flexible-usage tests and appendix analyses of backgrounds, multiple characters, extraction methods, early training behavior and failure cases are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-2 and all qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, AniDoc retains PSNR 19.23 and FVD 230.18 in Table 1, with identical baseline scores and rankings.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, training loss and correspondence/sparse-sketch definitions in Equations (1)-(5) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about reference-guided colorization, temporal consistency, handling reference/sketch differences, sparse-sketch interpolation and superiority to evaluated baselines.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations and interpretations are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning objects absent from the reference and differences in character clothing.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 retains identical optimizer settings, training steps, resolutions, hardware and training time. The code-access statement and hyperlink targets are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 67 reference entries, and the positioning relative to earlier colorization and interpolation methods are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, 18 December 2024, to v2, 30 January 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology and document organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-7 and S1-S6, Tables 1-2, captions, placement and page layouts are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the updated arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The only detected difference is the administrative version/date stamp. The method, evidence, explanations, limitations, reproducibility information and visual presentation are otherwise identical, including the appendices, so overall paper quality is unchanged.
